title: Junkyard Renegade: The Gearbox Gambit
summary: In an outlying vintage junkyard, a teenager with platinum-and-amber braids maintained a rickety freehold. Amidst burps and the hint of something amiss, they toiled. Armed with tools, they worked on a purple gearbox, greywater seeping, an ingrown mythology of failure looming. With every turn, an unspoken tension built. In overdrive, they fought a nasty carjack, villainy snatching, a bonehead killjoy affecting the outcome as madness surged. Victory claimed, the northern junkyard was vivified. Tyranny and terror replaced by creative habit, a nonjury of despair ended, their name cleared. The difficulty overcome, the world transformed, a new future beckoned.
